method: Reviewed the Reflexion paper and Anthropic agent-evaluation article for bounded descriptions, then audited the complete lesson. Ran its standard-library-only verifier with Python 3.14.7; complete synthetic fixture stdout matched the published text block. No model provider or external network calls. Built an isolated production copy (397 static pages), generated the Pagefind index (397 pages / 15,386 words), and visually inspected light/dark full-page captures at a 1300px viewport: article width 792px, no horizontal overflow, Mermaid rendered, console errors=0.

checks: distinguished Reflection self-review, feedback-based revision, Reflexion, and self-consistency
review result must be complete, parseable, and pass the task acceptance check
truncated, refused, malformed, and schema-incomplete responses are held
offline fixture output exactly matches published output

limitations: Historical 2026-10-09 prompts, responses, exact model snapshot, usage and scorer artifacts were not archived; answer-quality and token summaries were not recomputed.

The fixture uses synthetic weather observations and a fixed FakeReviewer; it tests only host validation/response handling and says nothing about model reflective ability, provider behavior, cost or latency.
The evaluation article and Reflexion paper provide bounded source descriptions, not proof that this application’s review strategy works or that its validator covers every task requirement.
